purpose: Original V1 atlas hashes and frame references for preservation during V2 re-export.

clips.label: Accroupi sur branche — entrée
clips.gridStrategy: round(i * atlasSize / 4); pad right/bottom with transparent pixels to ceil(atlasSize / 4), no resampling
anchorNotes: Ground anchor is the lowest alpha>=128 pixel; no automatic horizontal recentering.
This corrects image placement, not anatomical differences.
clips.anchorStatus: Décalages de lecture mesurés; appuis des pieds ou de la main à vérifier avec la géométrie du moteur cible. PNG source non déplacés.

Entry and exit are separately drawn; mask, arm, torso and foot shapes can differ across the join even after translation.
